passages.context: Section 10 was read with the end of section 9 and beginning of section 11. Jerome narrates Paula's visit to Bethlehem, says she declared in his hearing that she beheld the infant wrapped in swaddling clothes and crying in the manger with the eyes of faith, and reports her address hailing Bethlehem as house of bread where the Bread from heaven was born. The words are Paula's speech as represented by Jerome in a memorial letter, not a verbatim independent Paula artifact.
